title: Capacity, readiness and investment evidence
scope: A bounded primary-disclosure comparison of MP Materials and selected global projects; not a comprehensive facility census, country total, market valuation or investment recommendation.

stages.label: Cross-stage economic context
stages.form: Financing, company accounts and aggregate context

global_investment.geography: Diversified regions outside the leading supplier, China. Global scope; not a U.S.-only budget.
global_investment.product_scope: Magnet rare-earth supply chains: Nd, Pr, Dy and Tb; mining, refining and magnet manufacturing.
global_investment.total_status: Rounded modelled investment requirement, not committed funding or reported spending.
global_investment.scenario: The report projects demand under STEPS (existing and announced policy settings). The investment chart does not name a separate scenario.

stage_allocations.basis: The report separates mining from downstream processing.
Qualitative scale from the report and chart; no precise fraction reproduced.
Qualitative scale confirmed by page 53 chart and executive summary.

global_investment.method: Projected primary supply requirement and supply gap, combined with capital intensity. Includes existing expansions, announced projects not yet funded and the remaining new-project gap.
caveats: No public underlying CSV or project-level observations were available for the chart. Do not infer machine-level, element-level or qualification budgets.

The page 52 prose repeats “refining” for the approximately $21B category. The page 53 chart and executive summary identify magnet manufacturing; this interface uses only qualitative stage allocations.
Rounded chart stages need not add exactly to the rounded $60B headline. No exact residual or percentage is invented.
This is not a committed investment total, a current funding gap, a U.S. security budget or a cost-minimizing solution.
global_investment.source_locator: Report PDF pages 52–53; scenario context page 44.

rules: Do not annualize one quarter as observed annual output.
Do not sum concentrate-contained REO with its separated downstream products.
Do not equate magnet nameplate capacity, trial manufacture, qualification samples and qualified customer deliveries.
Do not apportion company/segment/project totals across individual machines.
Do not add financing/support commitments to facility cost, or double-count package components.
Null means not disclosed/verified in reviewed public evidence, not zero.
For money records, spent=true denotes verified capital/site cash expenditure; spent=false does not mean cash financing/prepayments were not received. Check kind and cash_received.
Keep original currencies. No foreign-exchange normalization or investment totals are calculated.
Quarterly and half-year output are never annualized, and annual capacity rates are plotted separately from period totals.
Product and physical basis stay separate: feed mass, contained REO, separated oxide, alloy and finished magnet are different quantities.

Complementary investments must be evaluated against usable product grades, conversion yields, customer acceptance and delivery deadlines. A capacity announcement alone does not establish available supply or an optimal spending order.

National all-REE estimates, administrative quotas, company blank production, finished-product sales, capacity and revenue retain separate measures. Company revenue is neither national stage value nor GDP; RMB amounts are not converted or added across stages.
